page_title: MCI 3-0 LIV | Manchester City v Liverpool 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
87' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
84' CHANCE! Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the left post.
84' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who has already been caught several times today.
83' Substitution. Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) has come on for Florian Wirtz.
83' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joe Gomez (Liverpool) replacing Conor Bradley.
83' What a big chance! Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
80' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
78' Liverpool can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

78' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.

77' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
75' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
75' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
75' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Alexis Mac Allister cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Jeremy Doku will be replaced by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).
73' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

72' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' The number of shots on goal at present is 6:0.
67' Wonderful movement by Liverpool. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
63' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the right post. Nico O'Reilly provided an assist for the goal.
60' Flag up against Milos Kerkez (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
59' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
58' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
58' A cross from Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Arne Slot prepares a substitution. Hugo Ekitike is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
56' The manager makes a subsitution with Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) coming on for Andrew Robertson.
56' A clumsy foul by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
56' Some great play by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
55' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
54' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Phil Foden (Manchester City).
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Cherki trots off the pitch and is replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).
52' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
51' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
49' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
49' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take a corner kick.

49' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) tries to find Jeremy Doku, but he puts too much power on the pass.
47' That's unlucky! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
45+6' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) will take the corner.
45+6' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
45+6' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
45+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Bernardo Silva passes the ball to Nico (Manchester City) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Giorgi Mamardashvili couldn't do anything about it. 2:0.
45+3' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+3' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

45+2' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
45+2' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is quickest to intercept the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
43' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
43' Nico (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
41' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.
41' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
40' The goal by Liverpool is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
40' Wait! Referee Chris Kavanagh has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
39' The score has changed – 1:1. Mohamed Salah sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) jumps highest and plants a header inside the right post.
38' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.
38' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
36' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Phil Foden (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
33' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
32' A pass from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.

29' 1 - 0 Goooooal! Matheus Nunes beats his man and slings in a cross towards Erling Haaland (Manchester City), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the right post from close in. 1:0.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nico (Manchester City) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

27' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Giorgi Mamardashvili. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
26' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) plays a through ball but overhits it.
24' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
23' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
21' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
19' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
18' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

18' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul after Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) hacks down one of his opponents.
13' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
12' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

12' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Liverpool) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Chris Kavanagh blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Manchester City.
11' The Manchester City players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

10' There's a break in play and referee Chris Kavanagh must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Manchester City using VAR. This could be interesting!
9' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Manchester City for a penalty. Play continues.
7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
4' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) jumps into a tackle and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul.
3' Manchester City showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
2' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will take a throw-in.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
